p: sanctified it: In Hebrew they sanctified it, that is, they finished it, and so dedicated it to the Lord by prayer, in desiring him to maintain it.
put not their necks to the: The rich and mighty would not obey those who were appointed officers in this work, neither would they help them.
throne of the governor on this: To the place where the Duke was wont to sit in judgment, who governed the country in their absence.
turning of the wall: Where the weapons and armour of the city lay.
the plain: Who dwelt in the plain country by Jordan and Jericho.
Nethinims dwelt in Ophel: Read Ezr 2:43.
sixth son of Zalaph: Meaning the sixth of his sons.
Miphkad: Which was the place of judgment or execution.
